[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stop the coverage-contexts lane crashing on global disk [/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]patches[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]coverage-contexts[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]coverage-contexts: CI Telemetry's coverage-contexts job dies in a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]pytest-xdist INTERNALERROR. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]test_inflight_handler_does_no_synchronous_disk_or_proc_store_work [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]patches os.stat and pathlib.Path methods globally with a raising stub. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Coverage's ctrace tracer then calls os.path.exists while the patch is [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]active and hits the assertion inside the tracer. Scope that guard so it [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]only sees the code under test. Audit the other tests that globally patch[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]os, os.path, or pathlib with raising stubs for the same hazard, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]prove the cov-contexts lane passes on the affected modules.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Make the test-cost lane finish inside its 180-minute timeout[/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]test-cost[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]test-cost: CI Telemetry's test-cost job is cancelled at its unchanged [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]180-minute timeout, about 93% through 60,399 items on 3 workers (run [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]42347892210). Full CI's test (3.12) runs the same items on the same 3 [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]workers in about 61 minutes, so the cost lane's own plugins (cost [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]recorder plus --sase-detect-global-leaks / --sase-fail-on-global-leaks) [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]add roughly 3x overhead. Find and remove that overhead. Then make the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]whole recipe pass: the run, test_cost_report, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]check_test_cost_budgets. Change no timeouts, budgets, or leak gates.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Make the contention-test lane survive and pass[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]contention[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]contention: CI Telemetry's contention-test job (SASE_CONTENTION_REPEAT=1[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]just test-contention, 26 workers on 2 pinned CPUs) prints nothing for [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]about 20 minutes. Then the runner gets a shutdown signal, on both the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]06:54 and 13:48 UTC runs on 2026-11-07. The lane has never produced a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tally in CI. Find out why the runner dies (memory or disk exhaustion is [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the lead) and fix it without changing the width, repeat count, CPU [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]pinning, or timeout. Then make the single repeat pass: root-cause each [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]failure under contention, or quarantine proven flakes.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Turn Full CI green alongside the sase-1r2.6 repair[/bold #D7AFFF]            [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]

    [#D7D7AF](107 first-pass drifts over the 25-node recapture cap) and test (3.12) [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](test_trailing_reserve_remeasures_when_flag_already_enabled wait_for [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]timeout, task bead sase-1qd). Phase sase-1r2.6 of epic sase-1r2 is live [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and recapturing the bulk golden drift. Coordinate with it rather than [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]duplicating it. Own whatever it leaves: the CI-only visual drifts it [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]recorded as follow-ups, the sase-1qd flake, and any other red. Repeat [/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
